WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    actor_id,
    COUNT(*) as film_count,
    COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film) as fraction
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
)
SELECT 
  actor_id,
  film_count,
  fraction,
  fraction - AVG(fraction) OVER () as difference
FROM actor_counts
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
